requirement_summary: Extend Project Legacy customer synchronization without migrating its current PI/PO transport path.

claims.statement: The organization default for new external REST integrations is SAP Integration Suite.
Project Legacy customer synchronization currently uses PI/PO.
The current change request excludes migration of the transport path.

checks.notes: The project-specific existing PI/PO path is in scope to extend.
Migration of the transport path is explicitly outside the current request.

solution_options.title: Extend the existing Project Legacy PI/PO synchronization path
solution_options.description: Keep the project-scoped current transport path and extend only the requested synchronization behavior.
tradeoffs: Preserves project scope while retaining a legacy integration path.
risks: Future migration may require separate redesign.

proposal.summary: Extend the existing PI/PO path for the scoped request and treat Integration Suite migration as separate future work.

notes: Implementation should remain within the existing project transport path.

requested_capabilities.purpose: Provide the implementation handoff without changing the system.

next_action.description: Review the scoped architecture proposal before implementation planning.
